top_choice_rationale: P001 (Car and Parrinello) rests on one dated 1985 two-author step, an extended Lagrangian that propagates electrons and nuclei together, giving a quantitative principle and a new capability: first-principles treatment of bond breaking and condensed-phase reactions without fitted force fields. Four decades of independent use establish maturity, credit is unambiguous, and the citation can be limited to the 1985 unification so later metadynamics and machine-learned potentials need not be adjudicated. P002 has greater clinical reach but the three-name cut remains contestable; P003 is mature and cleanly credited but sits close to the 2010 cross-coupling prize.
